The primary publisher's 24 April 2026 report explicitly places the 23 April fish-food festival in Karateren complex. Its article image was downloaded and visually inspected: festival cooks presenting dishes with the venue landscape behind them. Caption as an event scene; it is not a general architectural view. The different photograph on the pre-event announcement may be an older promotional illustration, so its exact venue/date are not confirmed and it is not added to meet a count.
